title: Visual colour setter
summary: Recovered the thiscall colour comparison, conditional four-component copy, and dirty flag update at 0x442f50.
test_description: Compare original and recovered object bytes for equal values, changes and quiet NaNs at each component, signed zero, infinities and existing flags; check input preservation and FS head restoration.
known_limits: The identities of other object fields and the broader meaning of the flag are unknown.
Unmasked floating-point exceptions, signaling NaNs, and unusual overlapping input storage are not validated.
